mechanism: Both drugs are teratogenic and cause immunosuppression; isotretinoin induces CYP3A4 which may reduce everolimus levels, while both increase risk of hypertriglyceridemia and hepatotoxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use due to teratogenic risk and overlapping toxicities; if unavoidable, require strict contraception, regular lipid and liver function monitoring, and everolimus level monitoring.
